subject.title: fix: prevent session-changed errors after reset

question: Should OpenClaw adopt lifecycleRevision as an optional shared field on both AgentHarnessResetParams and PluginHookSessionEndEvent for generation-fenced cleanup?
rationale: This is an additive cross-plugin lifecycle contract, so code-level correctness alone cannot establish its intended long-term ownership or compatibility commitment.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Accept the two optional fields as the supported lifecycle handoff and merge the Codex fencing implementation.

options.title: Keep the contract private
options.body: Require a Codex-local correlation design that avoids extending shared harness and plugin-hook types.

options.title: Pause for broader lifecycle design
options.body: Defer the PR until owners define a general lifecycle-generation contract for all harnesses and plugins.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Accept the two optional fields as the supported lifecycle handoff and merge the Codex fencing implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies Glucksberg as the earliest visible contributor to the retained-session reset path, though formal lifecycle ownership is not established in the supplied evidence.
